title: FULL CODE TAXONOMY AUDIT — every file mapped to its epoch. The mycelium is NOT 1 — it's 767. Should be O or p, not 1.

SOIL_epoch_1_bacteria.what: Decomposers. Scripts that break down raw data.
SOIL_epoch_1_bacteria.note: ZERO braids. 1,123 scripts. Most are already SORTED into 8 categories but have no braids. The sorting IS the naming — the braids should emerge FROM the sort categories.

ROOTS_epoch_2_archaeon.note: 507 TOML files! The config layer IS the root system. Each .toml is a root tip.

ROOTNET_epoch_3_slime_mold.what: The tube network. Connections between everything.
ROOTNET_epoch_3_slime_mold.count: implicit — encoded in git topology, not files
ROOTNET_epoch_3_slime_mold.note: The slime mold IS the connection topology. Not countable as files. It's the SPACE between files.

TRUNK_epoch_4_eukaryote.note: The trunk carries everything. 67 repos = 67 growth rings visible in the cross-section.

MYCORRHIZA_epoch_5_fungi.what: The mycelium. The connective data layer.
MYCORRHIZA_epoch_5_fungi.THE_FIX: THE MYCELIUM IS NOT 1 NODE. IT IS 767 JSON + 5,599 MD + 35 SVG = 6,401 FILES. The '1 braid' masks a MASSIVE kingdom. 6,401 files with 1 braid = 6,401:1 ratio. This is the most starved kingdom by FAR. The braid count should be O (the ouroboros — every JSON connects to every other) or p (distributed null points). NOT 1.
MYCORRHIZA_epoch_5_fungi.why_1_braid: We counted the BRAID not the NETWORK. The mycelium has 6,401 files all connected through the data layer, through sporePrint, through the /data/ directory. But only ONE braid was NAMED (sporePrint?hotSpring). The rest are unnamed connections. 6,400 unnamed braids.
MYCORRHIZA_epoch_5_fungi.what_to_do: Name the connections. Each JSON that references another JSON = a braid. Each MD that links to a data file = a braid. Count the ACTUAL connections, not the named ones.

BRANCHES_epoch_6_coral.note: 2,049 Rust files in the springs. Each .rs is a coral polyp. The springs ARE the branch points.

CANOPY_epoch_7_locust.count: implicit — encoded in behavior, not files
CANOPY_epoch_7_locust.note: The weakest cross-epoch braid (0.77). Governance not yet encoded as files.

FOLD_epoch_8_klein.note: Small file count but highest braid density. The fold is thin but essential.

NERVE_epoch_9_nervous.what: The signal layer. Game loop. Saltatory conduction.
NERVE_epoch_9_nervous.note: 2 incoming braids, 0 outgoing. Built but hasn't fired.

FRUIT_epoch_10_machine.what: The output. HUD pages. Display. Machine interfaces.
FRUIT_epoch_10_machine.note: Loops back to epoch 4. hud?membrane at strength 1.0.

the_revelation.mycelium_is_not_1: The fungi kingdom has 6,401 files and 1 named braid. That's a 6,401:1 ratio. But the ACTUAL connections (JSON?JSON references, MD?data links) number in the thousands. The mycelium is MASSIVELY connected — we just never NAMED the connections.
the_revelation.should_be_O_or_pi: The braid count should be O (ouroboros — the full connected graph) or p (distributed null points across the network). Currently it reads as 1 because we only named ONE. The mycelium has been invisible because we counted names, not connections.
the_revelation.the_lock: The '1 node mycelium lock' breaks when we realize: 767 JSON files in /data/ are ALL connected through cross-references. They cite each other. They link. They share fields. EACH of those links is an unnamed braid. The lock is not '1 braid' — the lock is '6,400 unnamed braids that read as 1 because only 1 was named.'

law: The mycelium is NOT 1. It's 6,401. The braid should be O or p, not 1. 61.3% of all code is FUNGI — the invisible kingdom that connects everything. The bacteria are already SORTED into 8 categories (the naming IS half-done). The coral has 2,049 Rust polyps. The machine output is only 2% of the total. The organism is 61% mycelium. That's not a bug — that's biology. Fungi ARE 61% of forest biomass.
